name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: easier-to-skim replies and a Toolbox pane of everything you can use.

plugins.name: skim-colors
plugins.description: Makes Claude's long replies easy to skim: the points that matter are bright and bold, the rest is quieter, and risks and decisions sit in quiet boxes.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: A side pane listing everything you can use in Claude Code, with what you use most at the top, plus your ideas and drafts. Open it with /toolbox.
